blocks.title: Diffraction
blocks.text: Roshni ka obstacles (rukawaton) ke kinaron se mur jana aur obstacle ke geometrical shadow (saaye) ke andar tak phail jana diffraction kehlata hai.

Agar interference ke experiment mein slits ki tadaad barha di jaye (aur saath wali slits ka faasla wahi rakha jaye) to maxima (roshan lines) usi jagah rehte hain, lekin do slits ke muqable mein zyada se zyada narrow (patle) hote jate hain. Yeh maxima itne patle hain ke in ka angle, aur us se wavelength, bohat precision (bilkul theek naap) se napi ja sakti hai. Is effect ke bohat se ahem istemal hain.

Bohat si parallel slits ki aisi arrangement, jin sab ki width (chaurai) barabar ho aur jin ke centres ka darmiyani faasla d barabar ho, diffraction grating kehlati hai. Pehli grating Fraunhofer ne fine wires (bareek taron) se banayi thi. Gratings diamond ki nok se glass ya metal ki surface par barabar faasle wali bohat si grooves (bareek lakeerein) khurach kar banayi ja sakti hain, ya kaghaz par kaali aur safed stripes (dhaariyon) ke pattern ko photographic tareeqe se chhota kar ke. Grating mein slits ko aksar rulings ya lines bhi kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab slit ki width (chaurai) ko bhi d likhti hai, jo slits ke centres ke faasle ka symbol hai. Har slit ki width alag aur chhoti quantity hai (aksar a likhte hain); d do saath wali slits ke centres ka faasla hai.

blocks.alt: Khari grating jis mein d faasle par paanch slits hain. Left se parallel gulabi rays aati hain; har slit se ray seedhi (dashed) direction se theta angle par neeche nikalti hai. Har slit par ray ka chhota mota hissa, jo neeche wali slit se dotted perpendicular line kaat-ti hai, delta L hai; oopar delta L = d sin theta likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.16: Diffraction grating (kitab ki Figure 15.16 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.alt: Laser diffraction grating se p faasle par screen par roshni dalta hai. Paanch gulabi lines screen tak phailti hain, oopar se neeche n = 2, 1, 0, 1, 2; pehle aur doosre order ke angles theta1 aur theta2 dikhaye gaye hain, dono beech wali n = 0 line se nape gaye.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.17: Pattern ke orders (kitab ki Figure 15.17 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 15.17 mein orders 'a = 2, a = 1, a = 0' chhape hain aur dono angles par θ₁ likha hai. Sahi nishan n hai (d sin θ = nλ), aur doosre order ka angle θ₂ hai, jo θ₁ se bara hai. Dono angles beech wali (n = 0) line se nape jate hain.

Fig. 15.16 transmission grating (jis mein se roshni guzar jati hai) ka cross section (beech se kaat kar dekha hua view) hai; slits page ki surface ke perpendicular hain, aur slits se guzarne wali roshni interference pattern banati hai. Diagram mein sirf paanch slits hain; asal grating mein kai hazar ho sakti hain. Do saath wali slits ke centres ka faasla d grating spacing kehlata hai. Aik plane monochromatic wave left side se grating par seedhi (normal, 90° par) parti hai. Hum far-field (Fraunhofer) conditions maante hain, yani screen itni door hai ke grating se nikal kar screen ke kisi aik point ki taraf jane wali tamam rays parallel samjhi ja sakti hain.

Bohat si slits ke principal maxima (sab se roshan nishan) unhi directions mein bante hain jin mein do slits wale pattern ke bante hain. Yeh woh directions hain jin mein saath wali slits ka path difference wavelength ka poora number guna ho. Is liye maxima ki jagah phir wahi formula deta hai:

blocks.text_alt: d sin θ = nλ where n = 0, ±1, ±2, ±3 …   (15.7)

blocks.text: Jab saikron ya hazaron slits wali grating par monochromatic roshni ki parallel rays dali jayen to pattern bohat sharp (patli aur saaf) lines ka silsila hota hai, jin ke angles is formula se milte hain. n = ±1 wali lines first-order lines, n = ±2 wali second-order lines, waghaira kehlati hain. Agar grating par white (safed) roshni dali jaye jis mein lagatar saari wavelengths hon, to n ki har value par pattern mein aik poora continuous (bina khaali jagah ke) spectrum banta hai. Har wavelength ka angle equation (15.7) se milta hai: kisi aik n ke liye lambi wavelengths (spectrum ka laal sira) zyada angle par hoti hain (yani seedhi direction se zyada murti hain), aur chhoti wavelengths (neela sira) kam angle par.

Equation (15.7) se pata chalta hai ke maxima ke angles ka sine λ/d ke proportional hai. Achhi tarah murne ke liye grating spacing d wavelength λ ke order of magnitude (taqreeban usi size) ki honi chahiye. Visible roshni (λ = 400 se 700 nm) ki gratings mein aam taur par taqreeban 1000 slits per millimetre hoti hain; d per unit length slits ki tadaad ka reciprocal (ulta, yani 1 ÷ tadaad) hai, is liye d taqreeban 1000 nm ke order ka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein wavelength ka symbol do jagah 'l' chhapti hai ('wavelength l' aur '(l from 400 to 700 nm)'); sahi symbol λ hai.
Hal shuda misal (worked example) (izafi, kitab ki nahi)

blocks.title: Izafi misal
blocks.problem: Aik grating mein 500 lines per millimetre hain. 600 nm wavelength ki roshni us par seedhi (normal) parti hai. First-order maximum ka angle aur sab se oonchi mumkin order maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: 500 lines per mm, λ = 600 nm = 600 × 10⁻⁹ m, n = 1.
Sab se oonchi order: sin θ 1 se zyada nahi ho sakta, is liye n ≤ d/λ = 3.3; n = 3 par sin θ = 0.90 (θ = 64.2°).
blocks.answer: θ₁ = 17.5°; sab se oonchi order n = 3

blocks.prompt: Diffraction grating mein zyada slits aur qareeb qareeb slits ke kya faide hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada slits maxima ko bohat patla aur roshan banati hain, is liye wavelength theek theek napi ja sakti hai aur qareeb qareeb wavelengths alag nazar aati hain. Qareeb slits (chhota d) orders ko bare angles tak phailati hain, yani spectrum zyada phailta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi grating par surkh roshni ki jagah neeli roshni dalein to pattern kaise badlega?
blocks.explanation: Neeli roshni ki wavelength chhoti hai, is liye har order ke liye sin θ = nλ/d kam hota hai: lines beech wale (central) maximum ke qareeb aa jati hain, aur zyada orders mumkin hote hain.

items: Diffraction: roshni ka obstacle ke kinaron se mur kar shadow mein phailna.
Grating: barabar faasle d wali bohat si slits; maxima patle aur sharp.
d sin θ = nλ (15.7); n = ±1 first order, n = ±2 second order.
White light: har order aik spectrum, laal zyada angle par; visible light ke liye d taqreeban 1000 nm.
